articleTitle: Chatbot Utilization for Medical Consultant System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Medical services are basic needs for human life although they normally have limited resources. Modern technologies are utilized for increasing service capability and decreasing the operation cost. Auto-response system or chatbot, which is widely known in the field of online businesses, can be applied to the medical services. Therefore, the objective of this work is to implement the medical consultant system service by using chatbot Technology. It was implemented based on the information of the symptoms and treatment records gathered from the DoctorMe application. The test results show the capability of the proposed system. Moreover, it can be used as a guideline for future improvement and also a guideline for future study.

articleTitle: Video Representation Learning for CCTV-Based Violence Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Ability to automatically recognize violence behaviors is one of the key technology for CCTV cameras. However, it is still a challenging task to obtain effective features for detecting violence in CCTV videos due to the visual quality of the video data. In this work, we propose a novel representation learning approach to improve the detection rate of violent behaviors in videos. Our proposed approach consists of two parts. In the first part, we leverage features extracted from image-based deep convolution neural network to describe spatial information in a video frame. We also introduce a new kind of image features, named multiscale convolutional features, to handle variations in the video data. In the second part, a bidirectional long-short term memory (LSTM) is applied to learn a video-level classifier from both violent/non-violent video sequences. Experimental results on three challenging datasets demonstrate that accuracy improvements are achieved by the proposed detection method compared with the previous methods.

articleTitle: IoT Based Water Level Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Nowadays, almost all communication using the internet, but is not all, now object also can communicating each other, this concept is calls the Internet of Things (IoT). Things in IoT can be everything that we use every day. In this project, the “thing” is a water container, or in Indonesia, it called “bak mandi”. Why water container? Because, after we use water in the water container usually the level of the water container is reduced and we must fill it up for other people that use the water container. Generally, in the process of filling the water container, we forgot to close the valve or pump so water is overflowing and the water is wasted. That is why we propose to use the Internet of Things concept that can solve the problem. Our approach utilizes a controller of ESP8266 that can provide monitoring level of the water container. That controller will open and close the pump or valve automatically so that the water is not overflowing and wasted. We use an ultrasonic sensor to sense the level of the water. We utilize the Blynk IoT service incorporated with PHP web programming in providing water level monitoring and control. We have tested the system on a 64 cm water container. The system has an error of 2 cm in controlling the water level.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing the Adoption of Agricultural Management Information Systems in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: In order to implement information and communication technology (ICT) successfully, it is important to understand the underlying factors that influence Agricultural adoption. Therefore, this research intends to study this perspective of factors that influence and impact successful ICT adoption and related agricultural performance. Case study and survey methodology was adopted for this research. Case studies in two Thai-organizations were carried out. The results of the two main case studies suggested 22 factors that may have an impact on ICT adoption in agriculture in Thailand, which led to the development of the preliminary framework. Next, a survey instrument was developed based on the findings from case studies. Survey questionnaires were gathered from 481 respondents from two large-scale surveys were sent to selected members of Thailand farmer, and Thailand computer to test the research framework. The results indicate that the top five critical factors for ensuring ICT adoption in agricutural were: 1) cost of ICT 2) software 3) tranning and education 4) farmer attitude to the use of IT, and 5) skill development in ICT. Therefore, it is now clear which factors are influencing ICT adoption and which of those factors are critical success factors for ensuring ICT adoption in agricultural organization.

articleTitle: Museum Interactive Information Broadcasting Using Indoor Positioning System and Bluetooth Low Energy: A Pilot Project on Trowulan Museum Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The tourism sector become a promising country income. This is because its nature which is not easily run out if managed properly. This sector can be a great support especially for developing countries such as Indonesia, because usually developing countries income only rely on natural and human resources income. Museums are one of the tourism sectors that have not been explored properly. Museums in Indonesia are still few that using the latest technology such as smartphone application, wifi, bluetooth, RFID. So, that it makes the museum a less attractive place to visit, especially for young generation. This research tries to create an interactive broadcasting museum information by utilizing applications on smartphones, indoor positioning systems, and bluetooth low energy beacons to provide information to museum visitors about artifacts around museum visitor location. As a pilot project a testing was conducted at the Trowulan Museum, Mojokerto, East Java, Indonesia, which is a museum that exhibits the relics of the Majapahit kingdom. The application has been able to provide interactive information about artifacts around the visitor's location so as to create an interesting museum to visit.

articleTitle: Y-Generation Digital Natives' Impulsive Buying Behavior
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper attempted to explore what cause Y-Generation digital natives' impulsive buying. Some valuable conclusions were found by the survey and statistical analysis. Panic atmosphere is the reason of the Y-generation digital natives' impulsive buying. Materialism, vanity trait and emotion have significant positive effects on Y-generation digital natives' impulsive buying. The participation has a moderate effect on Y-generation digital natives' impulsive buying, and regulation effects of achievement perception and emotion are significant. Demographic variables have influence on the Y-generation digital natives' online spending and impulsive buying.

articleTitle: Technical Analysis for Cryptocurrency Trading on Mobile Phones
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research studies cryptocurrency trading with an emphasis on technical analysis. In particular, the classic Turtle Trading System is modified to suit cryptocurrency trading. Based on backtest results on main cryptocurrencies, the extended Turtle Trading System yielded 114.41 % average net profit margin and 52.75% average profitability, which were higher than those of the original system. The trading strategy was next implemented in a mobile application. The application prototype is also presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Constrained Handling Techniques of Constrained Differential Evolution Algorithms Applied to Constrained Optimization Problems in Mechanical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Constrained optimization problems in mechanical engineering are very difficult for the optimization algorithm. In 2013, an improved version of constrained differential evolution, named ArATM-ICDE was proposed to optimize the constrained optimization problem. An archiving-based adaptive trade-off model (ArATM) was constructed to handle the constraints; resulting in an algorithm referred to as ArATM-ICDE. This paper applies ArATM-ICDE to solve constraint optimization problems in mechanical engineering. We also combine the penalty technique for constraint handling into the ICDE, named Penalty-ICDE; which compares the abilities of the constraint handling techniques. Our experiments were conducted on ten widely used constraint engineering optimization problems. The experiment results proved the ArATM-ICDE to be more reliable than the Penalty-ICDE. Additionally, ArATM-ICDE consumed a lesser number of function calls than Penalty-ICDE. This paper further compared the effectiveness of ArATM-ICDE and Penalty-ICDE with eight state-of-the-art algorithms, which revealed that ArATM-ICDE and Penalty-ICDE produced solutions of higher quality than those produced by the comparative algorithms. The ArATM-ICDE also consumed less effort in its process.

articleTitle: Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) and TOPSIS to Select Welding Process at Storage Tank in the Food and Beverage Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Selection of the most appropriate welding process usually depends on the experiences of a welder or follows the common welding process in similar companies. However, this approach ignores typically many criteria that can be affecting the suitable welding process selection. Therefore, knowledge automation through knowledge-based systems will significantly improve the decision-making process. The purpose of this research propose integrated data envelopment analysis (DEA) and technique for order of preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) approach for investigating the best welding process for storage tank in the food and beverage industry. The proposed approach compares each decision-making units (DMUs) with two virtual DMUs called ideal DMU (IDMU) and anti-ideal DMU (ADMU). Furthermore, the final result is determined by the relative closeness (RC) index. The proposed approach is used to give a ranking for six welding processes that are commonly used in the storage tank manufacturing.

articleTitle: Computerized Fuse Auto Changeover System with RS485 Bus Reporting & Multiple IOT Cloud Connectivity Avenues
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Fuse Auto-changeover system is a comprehensive system designed to Monitor & Backup fuses of various ratings for Indian railway signaling installations. The system can detect up to 16/24/32 fuses of 12v, 24v, 60v, 110v DC & AC. Traditional system used digital circuits to achieve the monitoring & changeover. Later system which incorporated microprocessor or micro controllers also employed the same for monitoring & changeover thus providing limited connectivity information such as a single potential free contact for an entire unit of 16 to 32 fuses. However, the proposed system incorporates a unique digital bus to propagate individual fuse status from each motherboard of 4 fuses in a unit of 16 to 32 fuses to the main/master unit controller which in turn provide the detailed status of main as well as standby fuses numbering from 16 to 32 fuses on a two wire RS485 bus with the hardware serial number or machine address of the system. Up to 255 units of fuse auto-changer system can be connected to a single RS485bus thus the proposed system provides a unique method of monitoring up to 32X2X255 fuses on a single RS485 bus.

articleTitle: Design the Feature Extraction for Real Time Inspection of Welding Quality
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The objective of this study is to design the feature extraction (time-frequency domain analysis) for detecting the mock-up weld defects (normal, porosity, irregular weld bead, and incomplete filling groove) in real-time at GMAW. Welch algorithm was implemented and improved for welding quality inspection by dividing into six frequency bands with a satisfactory sample size (512 samples/second). Frequency band 2 (frequency ranges 26-52 Hz) was selected for designing the internet of things (IoT) welding embedded system by proving the most sensitive to detect the mock-up weld defects.

articleTitle: Development of Diagnostic Method and Algorithm for Skin Type Based on Consumer Language and Sentiment
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: As the global cosmetics market is steadily growing, Korea's cosmetics market is also growing. In spite of the growth of the cosmetics industry, most of the recommendation methods based on the information received by the consumers without clearly knowing their skin type are based on the recommendation methods of existing cosmetics. Also, it is not easy to find recommendation methods based on accurate and objective indicators of the consumer's skin type. As for the customized cosmetics that have received much attention in recent years, the recommendation method is based on the self-questionnaire of the consumer or the skin type of the skin which is known to the user. However, the conventional skin type survey is often complicated and requires expertise to proceed on its own. In this process, the actual type of skin and the type of skin it is recognizing may be different, and the deviation from the desired ideal skin may be larger. Therefore, it is necessary to develop research method and analysis algorithm for diagnosis of accurate skin type and language which is easy for consumers to understand. In this study, we are going to make a diagnosis about current skin condition quantitatively through analyzing the current skin problem, distress, cosmetic use purpose and pursuing emotional distinction based on consumer language and emotion. The results of this study can be used as a guide for making customized cosmetics according to consumers' skin type and skin condition. Furthermore, if we combine cosmetics-related information and consumer reactions on various webs and apps, we expect it to be used as an index for recommending customized cosmetics.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Connectivity Oriented Telemedician System For Indian Landscape Using Raspberry Pi SBC & IOT
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The proposed system is based on Raspberry Pi Single board computer system. This system is designed to connect to any type of network such as GPRS, LAN, Wi-Fi for telemedicine. This system will serve as communication backbone for telemedicine implementation in rural India. Recently, remote healthcare systems have received increasing attention in the last decade, explaining why intelligent systems with physiology signal monitoring for e-health care are an emerging area of development. Therefore, this work adopts a system which includes continuous collection and evaluation of multiple vital signs, long-term healthcare, and a cellular connection to a medical center in emergency case and it transfers all acquired raw data by the internet in normal case. The proposed system can continuously acquire four different physiological signs, for example, ECG, SpO2, temperature, and blood pressure and further relayed them to an intelligent data analysis. The proposed system also has a friendly web-based interface for medical staff to observe immediate pulse signals for remote treatment. Once abnormal event happened or the request to real-time display vital signs is confirmed, all physiological signs will be immediately transmitted to remote medical server through both cellular networks and internet. Also data can be transmitted to a family member's mobile phone or doctor's phone through GPRS. A prototype of such system has been successfully developed and implemented, which will offer high standard of healthcare with a major reduction in cost for our society. By using this system doctors are easily communicate with high experience and forensic people.

articleTitle: Dealing with Change in Software Development: A Challenge for Requirements Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The research explored the requirements elicitation process in the development of Student Affairs Information Systems at one university. This system was developed by the internal team instead of outsourcing. An action research method was employed in order to examine how requirements should be handled; and implement the effective ways to carry out the elicitation process. The system development was divided into 9 phases starting from student activity system. During the elicitation process, four main problems were discovered: 1) users tried to avoid the interviews or reluctant to state their requirements; 2) users did not know how computers would change their work; 3) users asked for changes even after system was developed; 4) technology change was not taken into consideration. From these problems, some solving methods were applied during the elicitation process: 1) arranged study visits to obtain new ideas of software solution; 2) created prototypes to compare with users' requirements and experiences; 3) considered an issue of technology change to find possible applications of current technologies.

articleTitle: Proposed Amendments of Public Information Act Towards Data Governance Framework for Open Government Data: Context of Thailand
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Data Governance for open government data is a significant process which defines the roles and responsibilities of the person in charge of data management in a government agency to gain the open government data and to use it correctly, ensure the security of personal data including defining the standardization of data, consistency and effectively link and use open data between the agencies. Many countries have already considered data governance and dissemination of open government data to the citizen imperative. Although Thailand has prescribed a draft of public information act, data governance for government data is still unclear. Hence, this research proposes a conceptual legal framework for open government data in data governance aspects. The results of preliminary studies from the previous research are used in this paper including gap analysis and compare results between Public Information Act of the United States of America, the Republic of Korea and the current draft of Public Information Act of Thailand. The coverage issues are on the organizational structure, organizational roles, and responsibilities of Public Information Committee. The proposed amendments is applied in the current draft of the Public Information act for Thailand. This includes defining the standardization and security on open data by taking the existing data governance framework as a guideline for determining the procedures and compliance according to the data governance framework for Thailand.

articleTitle: Design of a Low Power DC-DC Buck Converter Utilizing Pulse Width Modulation and Pulse Frequency Modulation for Cacao Pod Maturity Testing Device
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper emphasizes the design of a high efficiency power management system through a DC-DC converter, applying the principle of Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) for conditions with heavy load current and Pulse Frequency Modulation (PFM) for conditions with light load current for a device. This design utilizes non-invasive spectroscope utilizing microwave frequency in the assessment of the maturity state of the cacao pods.

articleTitle: Streaming Media Implementation in Moodle-Based E-Leaming Application
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Teaching and learning processes develop over time, and the technology behind it are growing too fast, which makes the process of learning with online media (or often referred to as e-learning). This phenomenon is interesting to examine because some e-learning systems that exist today are not yet fully secure, in the sense that it is still easy to disseminate without any copyright and they are not used wisely. The purpose of this research is to produce an application that can be used as a media for e-learning of streaming audio and video without storing the file on local cache device so that the file residing in e-learning media cannot disseminated. As a research methodology using deductive qualitative method, data collective process done by literature study, interview and observation. After the data collected, the result is e-learning software based on website and mobile that can be used to stream media files without downloaded. The result of this research and analysis shows that streaming with RTSP protocol can be used in e-learning software with a limited number of users.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Problems of Current Smart City and Countermeasures in China
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Smart city is a concept related to the traditional city, and the product which is deeply integrated with the information technology and urban development. With the development of global wisdom cities, different construction ideas emerge endlessly around the world. The construction of smart city in China has also entered a period of rapid development, and it's gradually improved from political area to the area of industry and living hood. At present, four problems are faced by China's smart city, namely, fund problem, policy barrier, technical obstacle and service consciousness. Based on the successful domestic cases and industry trend research, we can promote the construction of smart city in China by using the diversified fund guarantee system, strong policy support, comprehensive technological innovation system and flexible service principle, assist the government scientifically, help enterprises in accurate marketing, improve the work efficiency of the people, strengthen governance, build businesses and benefit the people.

articleTitle: ReverseRoute: An Application-Layer Scheme for Detecting Blackholes in MANET Using Mobile Agents
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks (MANETs) are prone to many security attacks. One such attack is the blackhole attack. This work proposes a simple and effective application layer based intrusion detection scheme in a MANET to detect blackholes. The proposed algorithm utilizes mobile agents (MA) and wtracert (modified version of Traceroute for MANET) to detect multiple black holes in a DSR protocol based MANET. Use of MAs ensure that no modifications need to be carried out in the underlying routing algorithms or other lower layers. Simulation results show successful detection of single and multiple blackhole nodes, using the proposed detection mechanism, across varying mobility speeds of the nodes.

articleTitle: Academic Publishing Solution Based on LATEX Class Package Implementation for ITMSOC Journal
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The success keys of publication are the righteousness and precision of both content and formats required by many institutions, especially Information Technology Management program, Mahidol University. In the fields of publication, working on different versions of word processing and/or operating system software would deteriorate the publishing format quality. An implementation of L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">A</sup>T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</sub>X class package for ITMSOC Journal is proposed to serve the requirement of organization due to the high precise format for publishing. Based on minimal design, our package is derived from Elsevier class and template by combining into a single file of ITMSOC class, modifying the new logo and banner, and eliminating the complicated instructions for more convenience in utilization. Partially taken from IEEE class, a feature of biography with profile picture is also applied for the emotional value improvement of publication. With the powerful Linux shell scripts and modular design of file folder system, this package supports us to manage the files in it. articleTitle: Salted Eggs Manufacture Management of Information System: A Case Study of Seang - Detch Farm
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The salted egg is considered to be the well-known product and identity of Surat Thani. It is a One Tambon One Product (OTOP) product which is popular among tourists who come to the area. They normally buy salted eggs as souvenirs to indicate that they have been to Surat Thani. Currently, the production of salted eggs in the area of Chaiya district in surat Thani or even other areas that are not in Surat Thani have high competition in the market. Probably, it is derived from the diffusion of simple production and method. However, to produce salted eggs to be delicious, a big and tasty yolk eggs depends on how to raise ducks and a special way to produce salted eggs. If the amount of ingredients is not consistent, the product will not be standard. Therefore, in helping promote product management, there should be an emphasis on more systematic data storage to help produce products in time and so the system can calculate the raw materials needed to help reduce costs in manufacturing, and help eggs have enough quality of recipes. Also the system can report the quantitative data of production and quantity of raw materials to help check the stockpile of raw materials properly. It also supports decision making and executive planning. This is part of the way to grow your business effectively.

articleTitle: A Medical Knowledge-Based System Shell for Thai Physicians
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of a medical knowledge-based system shell or MedKBS Shell. The system is used as an online assistant tool of thai physicians. The components of the designed MedKBS Shell is composed of four subsystems. First, the Rule-based Knowledge Acquisition Editor is designed to add, edit, delete and manage domain knowledge from physicians. Second, the Medical Knowledge Base is designed to contain specific knowledge on the medical problem area as provided by the physician. Third, the Forward/Backward-Chaining Inference Engine is knowledge processor which is modeled after the physician's diagnosis. Fourth, the User Interface Unit is designed to ask question and interactive between the system and user. This system is developed and tested with five thai physicians. The study has indicated that the developed MedKBS Shell is accurate and reliable in acquiring and inferencing the domain knowledge. The MedKBS Shell can be employed as an effective and efficient online tool for developing medical knowledge-based system.

articleTitle: Dynamic SAR for Efficient Container Auto-Scaling Based on Network Traffic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: One of the important characteristics provided by cloud computing is dynamic scalability. For scaling cloud resources, a criteria is needed, such as a threshold. It may not be easy to setup the optimal threshold that minimizes cost and achieves SLA (Service Level Agreement), especially in the case of the sudden network traffic fluctuation. To cope with this issue, a fast, accurate method to predict network traffic is required. In this paper, EMA (Exponential Moving Average) and Parabolic SAR (Stop and Reverse) are mainly considered for predicting the volume and trend of network traffic. These two complement each other and would provide better performance for network traffic prediction. It is called Dynamic SAR in this paper. By adopting Dynamic SAR, an algorithm is proposed for efficient container auto-scaling based on network traffic prediction (ACNP). And also, through performance evaluation, the proposed algorithm shows that it can contribute fast, accurate container scaling on the case of sudden network traffic fluctuation.

articleTitle: Ionic and Metallic Bonding Visualization Using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is one of the smartphone technologies that can be used to experience three-dimensional object visualization with integrated information. It can also be used as a support tool for learning different topics. One of these is chemical bonding. Thus, this study aimed to visualize ionic and metallic bonding via the use of AR in order to improve the cognitive skills of students. A marker and three-dimensional model for each chemical element were created. Each marker exhibited a unique pattern that was tracked by the application to obtain visualization. The AR engine and game engine utilized by the application include Vuforia and Unity. This research study created a framework that can be redeveloped to facilitate other types of chemical bonding. However, additional rules, images, and illustrations for the application must be included in the framework.

articleTitle: Innovative Education in Cyber Security Field Through Collaborative Education
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative education model as a new curriculum framework. Due of multiplicity of variables we adopted an interdisciplinary dialogue with academic expert and professional from various companies especially in cyber security field. This interaction shown that there is a lack between universities and industrial sector regarding the current education system based on academic pattern, more particularly in cyber security domain. Indeed, the rapid change in the industry field and new technologies requirement are having a serious lateness effect on the education system. Therefore, it is pushing companies to train new recruits by themselves, creating a deaf dialogue between academic and industry actors. This paper gives a rapid overview of cooperative education patterns through different models and international cooperative education experiences across the world. After appropriate adjustment and understanding of the local context, we produced a new pedagogical organization for the master in cyber security; this implementation was particularly designed to involve both students and employees. A local company was involved during the whole process of the implementation and the future pilot project.

articleTitle: Software License Checking for Extended Enterprise Risk
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The data collected will be complete. There may be some errors in the storage of data each time such as overlapping data collection, non-collection of data etc. It is still used to review information from the team itself, so it has quite a delay and maybe it was a mistake because of the current team. There are no tools available to assist in reviewing the problem. Therefore, the project co-operative and the establishment have a concept of developing a tool to review the completeness of the results of the storage area for the software tool to be used to solve such problems. Documentation and data files are handled differently, based on the storage needs of the user with all inquiries from the team involved. The data obtained was analyzed and designed to be a system using the Python language to develop a script. The developer has developed a complete review tool for product reviews, licensed software products, and the ability to display results that the team needs. The results are as follows: displays synchronized and unmatched lists, including totals, each type is used in conjunction with a review of the completeness of the data in order to make the data more complete. [1].

articleTitle: Factor Analysis of Inventory Management in Thai Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The possession of well-organized inventory management is a key factor for a construction company to maintain its competence among competitors. Efficient inventory management leads to a higher-quality financial performance of construction projects as inventory-related cost can account for 60-65% of total construction cost. The purpose of this research study is to examine key factors affecting inventory management in Thai construction industry. A questionnaire survey was developed to gather data for an exploratory factor analysis (EFA). The results extract four key factors affecting inventory management, including `performance', `cost', `strategy' and `inventory policy', with a total of 15 associated items. The four key factors provide better understanding of inventory management in Thai construction industry.

articleTitle: Identifying Standard Testing Time for Estimation Improvement in IT Project Management
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The key interesting of executing the project to be success in the committed scope, time, cost and quality is the ability of estimating the required efforts and resources to be used in the project which potentially link to the delay and definitely cause to risk of loss in business opportunity, business reputation and financial impacts. There are several methodologies, have been proposed for the improvement but it is still uncertainty or unclear in the adoption of estimation guideline. Thus, this research is to propose more clearer and easier method to improve the mission of executing for project by introducing an adoption of Lean Six-Sigma methodology for the improvement of estimation for IT project. The outcome of this research is expected to provide the guideline of calculation method in specific organization in order to improve the efforts estimation for testing execution.

articleTitle: Real Time Boundary Density Based Moving Object Extraction
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The first task in motion detection and recognition is moving object extraction. After extract it, we perform representation model, or feature extraction prior to evaluate it with a classifier process. Failure in moving object extraction will contribute an error in detection and recognition process. This extraction is performed by processing of several frames to distinguish foreground from the background. In this paper we developed a simple extraction method which was suitable for real time application. The first stage, we performed moving object detection by using frames subtraction. This yielded boundary label in the motion area. This boundary label couldn't extract the whole moving object. For every row of image, we calculate the boundary density function. The probability of pixels in this density is used to extract them as foreground. The experimental result, our system can extract the moving object in computation time of 71 - 80 ms, video rate of 15 frames per second (fps) and image frame size of 640×480 pixels, which is suitable for real time application.

articleTitle: Theoretical Study on Working Capital Management Practices for Trainees
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Financial management directly associated with assets and liabilities enabling long or short term firm ailment. Enables vital activity of company with proper planning, shaping, regulating and monitoring both the material and financial resource required for the flawless organizational goal achievements. This study provides the details of working capital management practice essential in the evolving company. Management of every asset, namely inventory management cash management, receivable management crucially needed finance management on an organization. This gives the wholly general understanding for the novices on working capital and management of assets and liabilities of the firm. This study analyzes the liquidity and working capital management in developing management company. The financial position analysis comprises the process of identification of monetary strength and dimness of the company based on working capital management.

articleTitle: A Hanyu Pinyin Learning Model for Elementary School Students
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: To improve the primary school students' learning efficiency of hanyu pinyin, an innovative framework based on constructionism theory, which highlights the learner centered approach, serious play and simulation games is proposed for creating an active learning environment in classroom. The 2nd grade students at Puttisopon School was the target group. The learning process and students' learning outcome were evaluated by the observation of class participants, interview from students and the teacher. The data analysis was based on the statistical method of pre-test and post-test using dependent sample t-test. The result showed that the students' learning efficiency of hanyu pinyin can be improved under the active learning environment created by the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Develop a Communities of Practice Supported Training Process for English Teachers, Morejoy Education Training Center, Chongqing, China
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research is based on the problem existed among all K12 training center in China, and also occurred in the case study of this research, Morejoy Education. Morejoy Education is the market post of small-scale K12 training center, Chongqing. The common existed problem among K12 training centers is teachers' teaching performance cannot be enhanced through already existing training model in the training center. Researcher used interview to find out the prevalent problem is happened in Morejoy also. Owing that teachers are the key factor of training center, teachers' teaching performance influence students' learning outcome and training center's reputation, which helps to attract resources of students. By virtue of teaching record and Communities of Practice, an appropriate teachers' training process for small-scale training center is built, which aims at helping zero-year experienced English teachers to improve their teaching performance and solving the common problem.

articleTitle: Towards a Holistic Approach of Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper aims at proposing an original curriculum of sandwich training in cybersecurity in France responding to the context of the European shuffle on cybersecurity enforcement. Indeed, May of this year sets the milestone of the cybersecurity process in Europe and especially in France as it is the deadline for the transposition of the Network and Information Security European directive (NIS) on cybersecurity. This European directive is in line with the global crucial transition operating at all scales in the World. As a global concern, the cybersecurity capacity building of the next generations is at stakes. In order to formulate a viable and efficient training that meets real needs and challenges, we first analyze the current strategic and policy frameworks at many scales concerning the cybersecurity enforcement and awareness development. Once the best practices outlined, we would then analyze the current trainings provided in France in that field. Noting the lack of transversality of most of the existing trainings, we formulate an innovative proposition of training including a holistic approach by including a larger range of skills thus better in line to the international overhaul and contributing to the effective capacity building in cybersecurity.

articleTitle: The Entrepreneurial Behavior of Sake Brewing Business Owners: Research on the Business Change of Japanese Sake Makers in Shiga Prefecture
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Nowadays, small and medium-sized sake business owners in Japan are facing many challenges as the domestic consumption of sake has been declining continuously, and the nature of sake business has changed. Small-sized sake breweries in Shiga Prefecture of Japan were among the companies urged to shift their business model of subcontracting their products to major sake manufacturers into producing their own high-quality brands. This research is an investigation of the entrepreneurial behaviors of sake brewing business owners in Shiga Prefecture as they are embracing changes by a transformation in their business practice. By adapting to new strategies, these small-sized sake companies can differentiate their products from the major companies in terms of quality, distribution channel, and sales promotion.

articleTitle: Impact of Social Ties and Institutional Support System on the Performance of SMEs: An Empirical Study from Benin
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: It seems that no enterprise can thrive alone; all enterprises in general, SMEs, in particular, need a proper network to flourish. Thus, the peer-to-peer relationship between SMEs may influence their performance. This paper, using the partial least squares structural equation modeling technique, examines the influences of social ties and institutional support on the performance of SMEs in Benin. This study not only revealed the impact of social ties and institutional support on the performances of SMEs but also found that social ties have the most influence on SMEs' performance. Therefore, the government needs to amend their SMEs-oriented policy.

Author Keywords: Partial Least square Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM)

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Green Production of The Automotive Industry in Thailand: Frequency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Today, the environment around the world is threatened by the activity of humankind and its impacts have been increased by continuous utilization and exploitation of natural resources. Also, the increasing market share of automotive industry forces companies to seek environmentally friendly products or processes. The previous study has been conducted to study a consequence from improving greener products or processes. This study aims to identify a set of factors, from the previous perspective, for the automotive manufacturer. By performing the frequency analysis among 30 automotive related significant studies, the result confirms 12 factors: including Budget, Government Incentive, Corporate Social Responsibility, Training, Competitor, Material Availability, Energy Saving Carbon Dioxide Emission, Green Standard, Green Image, Green Customer and Safety. These 12 factors will be further used to develop a model to study the pattern and trend of the future automotive industry in Thailand.

articleTitle: Designing a Compilation Process for Handbook of Chinese for Specific Purposes: A Case of Trade Exhibition Chinese for Thai Entrepreneurs
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: To provide Chinese for specific purpose learning materials, the design of a new compilation process is required. In this study, design thinking, Delphi method, communicative syllabus design and knowledge management were used in the process. Thai entrepreneurs and Chinese language instructors were chosen as target groups. Descriptive analysis was used as a data analysis method. The results include research problem description and Chinese for specific purpose materials requirements, the main contents of trade exhibition Chinese handbook, and compilation process work flow. The new compiling process would benefit for guiding Chinese for specific purpose materials producers because it was applied the knowledge management process which plays an innovation part. The handbook could be helpful for Thai entrepreneurs to understand Chinese in trade exhibition domain and communicate well with Chinese people when they participate in exhibitions in China.

articleTitle: The Development of Instructional Packages of Op Amps and Linear IC for Curriculum Diploma of Vocational Education Students
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research designed the Instructional Packages of Op Amps and Linear IC for Curriculum Diploma of Vocational Education Students. The purposes of this research were 1) to study develop and test efficiency of the Instructional Packages of Op Amps and Linear IC and 2) compare the students' the instructional Packages of Op Amps and Linear IC achievement before and after using the Instructional Packages of Op Amps and Linear IC. The sample was 29 students of Diploma of Vocational Education Students in Chonburi Technical College in Thailand. The experimental instrument consisted of the Instructional Packages of Op Amps and Linear IC for Curriculum Diploma of Vocational Education Students. The statistics used for data analysis were E1 / E2, mean (M), standard deviation (S.D). The results showed that 1) the Instructional Packages of Op Amps and Linear IC for Curriculum Diploma of Vocational Education Students were 88.26/81.00, 86.40/90.00, 80.00/81.50, 85.00/81.00, 90.00/90.00, 90.00/83.50, 84.50/87.67, 84.50/88.00, 86.33/86.00, 92.88/90.00, 89.00/83.67, 85.00/82.0082.98 / 83.57, 84.64 / 85.71, 83.93 / 83.21, 81.43 / 84.29, 81.43 / 84.64 and 83.57 / 84.64, respectively, according to the 80/80 which was considered to meet the selected efficient standard criteria of 80/80, and 2) the students' scores had average score (E1) was 39.98, score of the test during the study had average score 216.61, and the average score (E2) was 117.16.

articleTitle: Rice Bran Stabilization Using Natural Organic Acids and Optimization Of Microwave Extraction on Free Fatty Acids and Protein
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Rice bran is a by-product of rice milling industry and a rich source of vitamin, protein, essential fatty acids, dietary fiber and other sterols. It is increased applications in food, nutraceutical and pharmaceutical industries. However, potential applications are limited by its instability owing to hydrolytic rancidity. In this study, rice bran obtained from Klong Yong Rice Mill was stabilized with the natural organic acid mixture and a novel extraction technique. It was conducted to find the suitable ratio of rice bran (RB) with natural organic acids (vinegar and lime juice) for stabilization and to compare the conventional and microwave extraction method in controlling the lipase activity and retrieved the highest protein content. The response surface methodology as Box-Behnken Design (BBD) was used to optimize free fatty acid and protein contents from stabilized rice bran (SRB) using microwave extraction. The minimum value of free fatty acid was 1.93% free fatty acid as oleic acid for 30-days storage with the optimum conditions of microwave extraction as follows: 2 min, rice bran was treated with 48.49ml of natural organic acids mixture with the ratio of solid to 95%EtOH as 1:4 wt./lvol. at energy 750 W. The highest protein content was observed 85.33% at the microwave extraction conditions of 5.45 min, rice bran was treated with 49.18ml of natural organic acids mixture with the ratio of solid to solvent (70.92% EtOH) as 1:4 wt.lvol. at energy 750 W. Therefore, SRB with natural organic acid mixture and microwave extraction were the alternative effective method for rice bran stabilization and protein extraction.

articleTitle: Creating Value Stream Mapping for Process Improvement on Human Resource Function: An Industrial Case Study
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Continuous improvement is done on processes of human resource function at PT X which handles employees, the company's important assets using value stream mapping (VSM). There were four prioritized processes. Contact Centre was analyzed that medical status was inquired because of incomplete supporting documents so the list should be provided at medical claim application. Automatic tick for eligible family members for MBA can eliminate the questions. Talent review was improved with an integrated tool for 9-box, succession, movement, and data consolidation. Employee referral process was improved with consolidation of processes and weekly monitoring interview for backlog issue of hold candidates. Employee life cycle execution was improved with reducing number of validations and increasing number of system synchronization. Lead time efficiency obtained after mapping future state for employee contact centre, referral program, life cycle execution was 70%, 21% and 67%. Process time efficiency obtained for talent review was 32%.

articleTitle: Text Mining Analysis on Determinants of Environmental Costs Expenditure as Time Series Data
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This study aims to read from environmental report which corporate management policy and strategy would promote the motivation of corporate behavior, especially the environment-related activities by listed companies. To do that, we analyze the relation between qualitative data and quantitative description using text mining technique. Our study aims to derive the result of more detailed analysis to confirm the change of positive factor by analyzing with text mining technique such as corresponding analysis, for environmental report in 2000-2011 in Japan. Time series analysis reveals that as CSR concept is widely disseminated, the focus of massage shifts from pollution aids to more comprehensive activities, which implicitly implies that the environmental report is currently recognized as a useful tool to effectively communicate a firm's social activities.

articleTitle: Integrating Monozukuri-Based Learning for Undergraduate Program in Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Monozukuri spirit is one of the keys to succeed in Japanese manufacturing and business and it has been applied in many human development processes including education. In this paper, we focus on the integration of monozukuri-based learning in information technology for undergraduate curriculum. It was designed and implemented in business information technology program to enable students to demonstrate their capabilities and skills to the utmost. It is imperative that teaching and learning with mind and kaizen need to be cooperative with appropriate technologies and interconnectivity of the relevant courses. Cloud computing is used in this study to enhance learning at any time, from anywhere and on any device. The course evaluations of 5 academic years indicate that the students have high degree of understanding monozukuri concept and gaining benefit of doing monozukuri project. The satisfaction in learning tools and technologies is also in high level. We believe that learning and working with monozukuri concept in mind will lead into the success for their professional career.

articleTitle: Model of Tracking and Identification System in Micro-Location Base
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The measure of personnel quality is important in the management of organizations. Therefore, there must be an efficient quality measurement system. The concept of Beacon device equipped with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) technology is used to identify a position in a building, and it also works with smartphones to verify identification. With a combination of both factors, the effectiveness of tracking and identifying people in the area increases. The purpose of this study is to study the feasibility of the beacon technology to position tracking and identifying people in micro-location base and to compare functions of tracking and identification of beacon technology to other technologies. The results of the analysis, designs, feasibility study and questionnaire for experts' opinions can be applied to make benefits to organizations and increase human resources management's effectiveness, with concerns of limitations and comparisons that may arise.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing Food Waste Management in Phnom Penh, Cambodia: Data Collection
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: In 2017, the average amount of waste was 2,215 tons/day. It is about 12% of total amount of waste increased yearly. In that, food waste is accounted for 57.40%, and that it affects badly on environment. This paper aims to perform data collection to identify key factors influencing food waste management in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. Interview survey is conducted based on eight hypothesized factors extracting from waste-related literature, including bio-digester, member in a family, packing size, population growth, promotion, shelf-life, shopping frequency, and tax payment. The results reveal importance of the eight key factors in managing food waste. It will later be used to build a dynamic model to track amount of food waste in the long term in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

articleTitle: Novel Constraint-Linearization Methodology for Designing High-Accuracy Phase Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper develops a novel approach to the optimization of a digital all-pass phase equalizer (apPE). It is well known that a digital PE plays an important rule in digital communications as well as a variety of digital signal processing systems with phase distortions. After showing the frequency-domain system function (transfer function) of the apPE as well as the cost function that is minimized in the design, this paper summarizes the apPE design formulation that involves a linear cost function and a nonlinear design constraint. In order to convert the nonlinear constraint into a linear design constraint, an alternative novel constraint-linearization method is presented, which can approximate the nonlinear design constraint as a linear design constraint. Consequently, a digital apPE can be designed by applying a linear optimization algorithm. Computer simulations are given for demonstrating the usefulness of this new constraint-linearization-based apPE design methodology.

articleTitle: Computerized Medical Device Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research aims to design and create a computerized medical device management system (CMDMS) which based on the principle of computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) This system operated by web application and database system on the server as well as management system maintenance of medical devices in the hospital. The design and construction of CMDMS composed of 3 main parts: 1) preventive maintenance (PM) system 2) corrective maintenance (CM) system and 3) pooling system. Recently This system has implemented at Pathum Thani hospital. The system tests found that it works perfectly according to the primary purpose of every user's aspects.

articleTitle: The Distinction Learning Style in Learning Outcomes of the Secondary School Learner
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Lifelong learning is a sustainable education, which can provide learning management as appropriate to the potential of the students. Thus, this paper is aimed to study about the factors (courses) that affect the design of learning styles in upper secondary level from lower secondary level, develop a model of education that supports the appropriate learning styles in upper secondary school, and evaluate the effectiveness of the education model. The dataset was collected from 603 lower students and 626 upper students at Phadungnaree School in Mahasarakham, Thailand. The scope of the dataset is six academic years from 2010 to 2015. The research tool consists of four machines learning, including k-means, decision tree, k-optimization, and cross-validation methods. The results showed that the number of appropriate class for school management is equal to three clusters (classrooms) while the signification factor is 21 factors in 3 groups. The model performance is very high with 82.47 % accuracy. For the future works, it can be applied in the model analysis for designing and developing applications needed for institutions.

articleTitle: Social CRM Analytics Model on Malaysian Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs)
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)

authors.preferredName: Raja Mohd Tariqi Raja Lope Ahmad

abstract: Institutions of Higher Learning in Malaysia have a very tight competition to obtain new customer and to retain existing customer due to many public and private institutions available in the market. Many private IHLs suffered from financial losses because of the declining number of students' enrolment. Social media has become a domain for investments to companies and it is recognized as a means of maintaining long-term relationships with their customers. Customers or students now have multi-modal relationships with businesses which are mostly digital and exist across social media platforms. Companies investing in resources to integrate social data into existing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems enable them to understand customers and at the same time fulfil their best interests. In addition, IHL strategic marketing needs to respond to the digital era by applying social media informed research. This paper will produce a Social CRM Analytic model for the IHLs to assist them in taking actions on the customers' problems or complaints. The model may also be suited to organizations with relationship-oriented characteristics of social media technologies. The previous study was used to support the model and selected IHLs are applied to this model. The results from this model shows issues that need to be resolved and actions to be taken immediately to ensure customer satisfaction, loyalties and good reputation of the IHLs.

articleTitle: Wannabe Effect: The Study of Wishful Identification and Prosocial Media Effect
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Since wishful identification was a significant predictor of both general and negative media effect, the current study primarily aimed to test if media preference, perceived character's positive attributes (heroism, braving, intelligence, and gratefulness), perceived similarity, and character's attractiveness could predict wishful identification which should bring about belief in prosocial message from media. Twenty college students were asked to complete questionnaire and other 80 primary school students were interviewed by their teacher who wrote on the questionnaire for them. The finding reveal that wishful identification performed as the mediator between three predictors, movie preference, perceived similarity, and character's attractiveness, and the dependent variable, belief in prosocial message from media. However, perceived character's positive attributes failed to predict both mediator and the dependent variable. This study suggested that film makers may choose to increase audiences' movie preference and perceived similarity in order to heighten their wishful identification with heroic characters who have prosocial behaviors.

articleTitle: The Automotive Factory Strategic Board Game for Fostering Business Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Business simulation game is gradually utilized among business consulting firms in Thailand, especially the board game version for training strategic business skills of their clients. However, the majority strategic board game have developed from the West which having some business culture difference. This article presents the philosophy and objectives of the game for fostering business sustainability and some desired features from stakeholders' views, also their expected benefits from playing this Automotive Factory Strategic Board Game (AF-SBG). The results of the several focus group with the dedicated stakeholders such as prospect players and the training organization's management also the game developers shown that the philosophy of the game should be to create sustainable competitiveness in the digital economy by applying the Sufficiency Economy Philosophy (SEP) with innovation and technology in running business for sustainability. The significant features of the game are 1) having a virtual look at how to practice business decisions with responsibility, 2) practicing players to apply the SEP in business culture and values, 3) presenting distinctive, beautiful, virtual, three-dimensional of board game, 4) players be able to change or play as a variety of business roles, and 5) a simple and easy-to-play simulation game and stimulating the players to learn business strategy with fun.

articleTitle: The Effects of CEO's Personality on Knowledge Transfer and Innovative Performance in Thai SMEs
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: In order to survive in business world, an organization needs to adapt itself to suit with both external and internal environments. Once an organization sets up its goals, visions and missions, a set of strategic plan would be implemented. To achieve each organization's strategic plan and objective, knowledge transfer is mainly utilized in many organizations because knowledge transfer is a key to create an organization's core competency. This research investigates the effects of knowledge transfer among top management team (TMT) members on firm's innovative performance as well as examines the relationship of CEO's personality traits and TMT knowledge transfer. The proposed conceptual model was developed based on the combination of team learning process model, knowledge transfer processes, leadership behavior in teams, and personality traits. The methodology techniques used in this study included correlation analysis and multiple regression analysis. The sample size in this study was 211. The results suggest that CEO's conscientiousness, emotional stability, and agreeableness have positive relationship with knowledge transfer among TMT members and TMT knowledge transfer is able to predict firm's innovative performance in Thai SMEs.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Classification of Geometrical Data Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Land use or Land cover management is fundamental process for agricultural development. Remote sensing image can provide useful geometrical data for agricultural development. The unsupervised classification plays an important role to build the map of land use. The accuracy of classification is therefore crucial. There are several classification methods such as K-Mean, ISODATA and Self-Organizing Map (SOM) that are applied to classify land use on geometrical data. However, none of these method can provide the classification accuracy over 52%. The classification method with high accuracy is indeed needed. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) could be used to do classification tasks. However, the standard PSO is not suitable to unsupervised classification of remote sensing image. Unlike other complex variation of PSO designed for unsupervised classification, this paper presents the simple adaptation of PSO to unsupervised classification of land use. The sample area is in Ayutthaya province, Thailand which is agricultural area. The field survey is sampled to assess the classification accuracy of the proposed method. The assessment concluded that the proposed method has accuracy up to 73.00% which has approximately 1.4 times more accurate than previous method based on SOM.

articleTitle: Tracking Strategies in Long Term Care
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: For not-for-profit organizations (NPO) that compete on billable services (like most Singaporean hospitals), the nature, importance, and practice of strategy differs little from for-profit organizations. Yet there are few case studies on strategy in NPO or in long term care (LTC), where NPO are state-contracted vis-à-vis guided competition and cluster development. These environments are competitive, uncertain, and sensitive to interventionism. Thus, this paper fills a longstanding research gap by tracking the strategy of Organization X (X), among mid-sized LTC NPO in Singapore. Following Mintzberg (2007), we consulted public information and mapped key activities and effectiveness over 3 financial years. We then conducted interviews and sought in-depth materials, extrapolating findings onto the planned change model (PCM) to surface complexities and insight. Overall, X underwent rapid expansion and experienced sharp dips in effectiveness under a new Chief Executive Officer. Our findings suggest an emergent, entrepreneurial approach to strategy at X. Patterns of change were very stable, mostly corroborated by financial valuation, performance, and staff attrition. In comparison, organizational development was culture-driven, with similarities to Mintzberg's (2007) case study on Canadian Lady. A unique characteristic of this case was a leader who claimed a “spiritual mandate” to proselytize, and whose perception of strategic change as “reach” pervaded the organization. Another characteristic was the systemic absence of knowledge management, which may have contributed to X's ineffectiveness (including 2 years of missed subsidies for 12 facilities). We conclude with implications for payers, regulators, organizations, and scholars. These include the need to better incentivize the effectiveness of LTC NPO and reiterate PCM through synthesis with complexity theory.
